title: New Generation Fixed-Chamber Press 540 AutoCut Review
reason: The video describes a new generation of stationary bale press machine with several technical features and improvements.

tasks.task: Highlight the key features and improvements of the new stationary bale press machine.

subtasks.text: Observe the reinforced design of the chassis and rolls, as well as the mixed netting or film lacing system.
Note the easy switching between modes by lateral guides of the roll guidance system.
Describe the capability to produce bales with a diameter of 1.25 meters and a width of 1.22 meters.
Highlight the design with a 2.1-meter pickup cam and dual roller tacking in the option, along with lateral feeders that evenly supply the rotor.
Explain the system with 15 attachable knives that offer a theoretical cutting length of 70 mm.
Describe how each knife is individually protected against foreign objects and can be lowered to clear the cut if necessary.
Explain the new rear hinge system's advantages, including reduced stress on hinges and constant pressure, with hydraulic cylinders set to 180 bar.
Mention the availability of NPS2 option, which includes a segment with 3 pivoting rollers in the chamber to further compress the forage.

tasks.task: Highlight practical aspects of the machine, such as service accessibility and proportional lubrication.

subtasks.text: Describe the global review access and the proportional lubrication provided by an eccentric pump driven by a 6.3-liter oil tank.
Note the rear door oilers being concentrated on the right side of the machine.
Mention the option to store netting or film roll on the right side of the machine.
